configure.title: Protect questions
configure.description: auto: only when the site has no open license (a private course, not OER); always; never

configure.title: Question elements
configure.description: Comma-separated tags whose answer keys are kept on the server (elements with light-DOM <input data-correct> answers)

configure.title: Ignore scripted input
configure.description: Drop clicks, keys and drags a script generated (event.isTrusted is false) on guarded questions; they are always counted

configure.title: Fast answer threshold (ms)
configure.description: Flag an answer checked sooner than this after the question appeared

configure.title: Time between checks (ms)
configure.description: A learner must wait this long between checks of the same question, which slows trying every option

configure.title: Honor prompt
configure.description: Shown once per page before the first check; leave empty for none
